{{Top|leg}}
'''Holam''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Holam commented on the entry for [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn's]] [[Merr-Sonn stun baton|stun baton]], relaying how they increased in popularity after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] eased certain weapons laws.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
